The '''kleptomaniac pilot''' was among the rejected [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] candidates for [[Wraith Squadron]]. A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]], he was subject to a [[Court-martial/Legends|court-martial]] for theft when he interviewed with [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] for a position in the Wraith Squadron. During the meeting, he stole a family [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] from Antilles; [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] apprehended him and Antilles rejected him from the squadron.
